description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao class in the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup and test methods for retrieving, saving, and editing US employee tax exemption data within the Pim module.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing EmpUsTaxExemptionDao methods related to employee US tax exemption data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and populates test data from fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee tax exemption record by employee ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee tax exemption record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests editing and saving updates to an existing employee tax exemption record.
